name: performance_history
description: Use when the user reports a loss of power or slow acceleration and you need the 0-100 km/h, drag or braking runs measured in this app session.
instructions: Call read_performance_history {} once: it lists this app session's 0-100 km/h, drag (60 ft, 1/8 and 1/4 mile) and braking runs for this car, newest first, with their dates.

Runs are kept only until the app closes. When there are none, do not ask the user to drive one now: the car is stationary during a diagnosis. Mention that the Performance screen can measure one on a safe, closed road later.
interpret: Speed comes from the ECU speed PID (010D), polled about 10 times a second at best: a run under 5 Hz is coarse, so times can be off by a few tenths of a second.

Compare runs with each other and with the car's published 0-100 km/h time: a run more than about 20 % slower on a dry, flat road points to a real loss of power (boost, fuel delivery, a limp mode), worth checking with live data and fault codes.
A 0-100 km/h run marked not reached never got to the target; its max km/h tells how far it got.
Braking from 100 km/h to 0: about 35-45 m on a dry road for a car in good order; clearly longer points to worn brakes or tyres, or a wet road.
